reviewer: Codex, separate T3 fixture semantic review, 2026-09-16

citation_support.findings: The only indexed external statement equals the retained synthetic paragraph, which says only that fixture-batch was tested. It makes no safety claim. The three legacy observations explicitly lack source access and receive no verified conclusions.

variant_applicability.findings: The fixture source and B000000001 agree on Tilda, Pure Original, 5 kg, DE and fixture-batch. These are synthetic identity fields, not evidence about a real listing. No legacy finding is applied to a current batch.

user_priorities.findings: The brief asks for listed EUR/kg, with delivery unknown. Prices are 3, 4 and 5 EUR/kg. The positive brief requires two candidates and selects the first; the insufficient brief requires four and selects none. Scores do not determine selection.

coverage_and_limits.findings: The report limits itself to three synthetic named records, no queries or live collection. The retained source explicitly says synthetic; legacy source access and batch limits remain visible. Observations are two days old relative to the fixed fixture reference date.

unresolved_limits: No real external laboratory document was acquired or verified.
No finding here establishes safety or suitability of a real current product batch.
Delivered costs, marketplace coverage and live freshness are unmeasured.
